reasons.requested: at least 10% of return from features inside a 50x ceiling
reasons.achievable: a feature-free profile inside a finite ceiling, or a feature profile with no finite ceiling
reasons.detail: A reachable free-spin award can retrigger without a configured count limit, so a complete paid round has no finite return bound that a player cannot exceed. Requesting feature contribution above zero together with a finite hard ceiling is therefore unprovable, and this adapter refuses instead of narrowing the claim.
